title: 2024 Topps Allen & Ginter Buzzin' #BUZ-15 Hornet Insect Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2024 Topps Allen & Ginter trading card featuring a Hornet from Brooklyn, New York. The card is part of the Buzzin' subset, highlighting insects as the sport. It is a non-autographed card manufactured by Topps and numbered BUZ-15, representing the 2024 season. This unique and collectible card appeals to fans of sports trading cards and offers a fun and educational aspect with its focus on a lesser-known athlete, the Hornet.
